personal.name: Spoorthy K.R.
personal.tagline: Hi, I'm Spoorthy. I build systems that connect AI research with production-grade software, from agentic RAG and financial disclosure search to deep learning models for signal detection and medical imaging. Previously a Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase, I engineered high-volume financial infrastructure. I know what it means to build at scale with zero margin for error. Now I'm bringing that rigor to agentic AI at Jefferies.

highlights: Re-architected a 40-year legacy FX settlement platform into Spring Boot microservices, scaling system capacity to handle $10–15B in daily transactions across 250–300k trades with improved fault isolation and service modularity
Designed event-driven workflows using Kafka to decouple services, improving system resilience and enabling real-time processing across legacy and modern platforms
Converted REST APIs to GraphQL, reducing frontend payload sizes by 40% and cutting page load times by ~100ms across trading dashboards
Optimized FX Options settlement pipeline to achieve 95% STP (Straight-Through Processing), reducing manual intervention and improving end-to-end system throughput
Migrated Oracle databases to secure cloud infrastructure with near-zero downtime using blue-green deployment strategies
Built Python automation tools for regression testing and environment setup, saving the QA team 7–8 hours of manual effort weekly
Improved system reliability by automating regression testing (FitNesse), reducing deployment risk and increasing release confidence
Raised SonarQube security score from 65% to 80%+ and embedded static analysis into CI/CD pipelines to enforce code quality gates
Enhanced production stability by resolving high-priority incidents and improving monitoring, minimizing downtime in a mission-critical trading system
Led end-to-end development of a real-time Kubernetes microservices monitoring platform with a React frontend and Spring Boot backend
Implemented dynamic pod scaling and auto-recovery mechanisms, reducing manual intervention during traffic spikes
Built live log streaming and aggregation using WebSockets, enabling real-time debugging across distributed services
Designed a health monitoring dashboard with granular service-level metrics, uptime tracking, and dependency mapping
Cut incident resolution time by 40% by implementing real-time failure alerts with configurable severity thresholds
Integrated Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards for long-term observability and performance trending
Built an end-to-end NLP preprocessing pipeline with spaCy and NLTK for parsing symbolic test reports from EV (Electric Vehicle) testing systems
Designed feature extraction workflows to convert unstructured text data into structured feature vectors for downstream ML models
Trained and evaluated Random Forest & SVM classifiers achieving 85%+ accuracy on EV testing datasets, with hyperparameter tuning via grid search
Developed a prediction interface that reduced manual test instruction effort by 60%, enabling engineers to auto-generate test sequences
Presented findings and a working demo to the Bosch R&D leadership team, receiving commendation for project impact

projects.title: Constraint-Aware Financial Disclosure Search Engine
projects.subtitle: CSCE 670 · Information Retrieval System
projects.description: Passage-level SEC 10-K search engine for S&P 100 financial disclosures that combines BM25 lexical retrieval, FinBERT-style dense search, OpenSearch hybrid ranking, and structured constraints over year, sector, geography, ticker, and company. Returns citable evidence passages with transparent score breakdowns, mismatch penalties, and coverage-aware ingestion for missing filings.

projects.title: Critic-Guided Iterative RAG for QA
projects.subtitle: CSCE 638 · Agentic RAG Research
projects.description: Built an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with an LLM-based context critic that iteratively rewrites queries and re-retrieves documents, outperforming single-pass RAG baselines on multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, SQuAD v2.0). Evaluated three retrieval pipelines across two LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-2B) using dense retrieval with SentenceTransformers and FAISS, measuring Exact Match, Token F1, ROUGE-L, and CharF1 to quantify the impact of critic-guided feedback on answer accuracy.

projects.title: Signal Detection in RSMA
projects.subtitle: IEEE NCC 2023 — Lead Author
projects.description: LSTM-based signal detection for beyond-5G networks using Rate-Splitting Multiple Access. Outperforms conventional algorithms in noisy, multi-user channels using temporal sequence modeling to minimize bit error rates.

projects.title: Radiogenomic Brain Tumor Classification
projects.subtitle: IEEE INDICON 2022 — Lead Author
projects.description: Transfer learning with ResNet & AlexNet to predict IDH genetic biomarker status from MRI scans, enabling chemotherapy response prediction. Achieved 82% accuracy on the RSNA-MICCAI dataset via 3D slice extraction and advanced augmentation.

projects.title: AI-Powered Document Classifier
projects.subtitle: LLM + OCR Document Processing API
projects.description: FastAPI service that processes PDF uploads, extracts text with PyMuPDF and OCR fallback, computes page-level legibility signals, and classifies documents using local LLM inference through Ollama. Includes a Swagger API interface and deployed Heroku endpoint for interactive testing.

projects.title: NLP Topic Summarizer
projects.subtitle: Multi-source Summarization Platform
projects.description: BART transformer-powered platform that scrapes raw web content via BeautifulSoup, then generates coherent multi-source topic overviews using abstractive summarization. Deployed with an interactive Flask frontend.

projects.title: Financial Research Agent Platform
projects.subtitle: Automated Financial Analysis & Insights
projects.description: Agentic platform that performs comprehensive financial research, analyzing market data, company performance, and news sentiment. Provides actionable insights and structured reports through an interactive web interface.
